history.summary: Compact 667 sqft 2BR in West Coast (D05) at a low $1.0M quantum and $1,499 PSF, just under the $1,548 URA median, but with a weak 1.16% appreciation over a reliable 104 txns. The low entry price and One-North catchment help, but flat price history is a real drag for a 5-7yr hold.
history.rating_rationale: 1.16% URA CAGR over 104 txns is well-evidenced and genuinely weak — this development has barely appreciated. Offsets: $1.0M quantum is highly liquid, $1,499 PSF sits just below the $1,548 median, and D05/One-North supports tenant demand. Cheap and liquid, but the growth case is poor.
red_flags: Very low 1.16% appreciation over 104 txns (well-evidenced weakness)
667 sqft efficient but no MRT listed nearby
Price stagnation suggests limited upside on exit

history.summary: A modestly real discount on a well-built Far East 1BR in a favorable West Coast (D5) region, but Seahill is a documented strong-yield/weak-resale name with no MRT and flat capital appreciation, so it's a rental play rather than a capital-growth buy.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,510 PSF (635 sqft, $959k) verifies as modestly cheap: comparable 1BR listings are $1,575-$1,599 PSF and recent 1BR transactions $1,543-$1,656 PSF, against a project median ~$1,484 over 133 txns. So roughly 2-4% below current 1BR comps — real but small (psf_cohort_txns=8, age_adj -19.6%). Developer Far East Organization gives good build quality (positive). D5/West Coast sits in the favored OCR-RCR forward-return band under v3.4 priors (+3.5-4.0% vs CCR ~0.7%). However, Seahill is well-documented for 'good rental yield but poor resale performance' with many owner losses, no MRT within walking distance, and only ~1.16% trailing CAGR — the capital-appreciation story is absent. 45 rentals in 6 months shows brisk leasing demand. Net: fair-to-slightly-cheap entry with reliable rental but weak exit appreciation = Neutral, leaning to a yield buyer.

No MRT within walking distance (key liquidity/demand drag)
Only ~1.16% trailing CAGR; flat capital appreciation history
Discount vs comps is real but small (~2-4%)
catalysts: Far East build quality and large-amenity 338-unit development
D5/West Coast region in the favored OCR-RCR forward-return band
Strong, brisk rental market (45 lets in 6 months) supports yield
